notes: The design lays its flanks out for a panel whose x runs along the car, as
the Tatuus does. On this car the door x runs up the car, so the names had
a quarter of a metre of length and shrank past reading; the number landed
on the island the left fender shares with the door, and drew on the door.
These put the board, number and team on the door and the sponsors along
the rear quarter, with the length they need, written for the left and
mirrored through the measured axes, since the right flank is the left one
